# Mini-Go package reference

## Packages

- [`bufio`](packages/bufio.md) - Package bufio implements buffered I/O.
- [`bytes`](packages/bytes.md) - Package bytes implements functions for the manipulation of byte slices.
- [`cmp`](packages/cmp.md) - Package cmp provides types and functions related to comparing ordered values.
- [`container/heap`](packages/container/heap.md) - Package heap provides heap operations for any type that implements heap.Interface.
- [`container/list`](packages/container/list.md) - Package list implements a doubly linked list.
- [`container/ring`](packages/container/ring.md) - Package ring implements operations on circular lists.
- [`context`](packages/context.md) - Package context carries cancellation, deadlines, and request-scoped values across Mini-Go call boundaries.
- [`crypto/hmac`](packages/crypto/hmac.md) - Package hmac implements the Keyed-Hash Message Authentication Code (HMAC) as defined in U.S.
- [`crypto/rand`](packages/crypto/rand.md) - Package rand implements a cryptographically secure random number generator.
- [`crypto/sha256`](packages/crypto/sha256.md) - Package sha256 implements the SHA224 and SHA256 hash algorithms as defined in FIPS 180-4.
- [`embed`](packages/embed.md) - Package embed provides access to files embedded by //go:embed directives.
- [`encoding`](packages/encoding.md) - Package encoding defines interfaces shared by packages that convert data to and from byte-level and textual representations.
- [`encoding/base32`](packages/encoding/base32.md) - Package base32 implements base32 encoding as specified by RFC 4648.
- [`encoding/base64`](packages/encoding/base64.md) - Package base64 implements base64 encoding as specified by RFC 4648.
- [`encoding/binary`](packages/encoding/binary.md) - Package binary implements translation between numbers and byte sequences and encoding and decoding of varints.
- [`encoding/csv`](packages/encoding/csv.md) - Package csv reads and writes comma-separated value files.
- [`encoding/hex`](packages/encoding/hex.md) - Package hex implements hexadecimal encoding and decoding.
- [`encoding/json`](packages/encoding/json.md) - Package json implements JSON encoding, decoding, and incremental streaming.
- [`encoding/pem`](packages/encoding/pem.md) - Package pem implements the PEM data encoding, which originated in Privacy Enhanced Mail.
- [`encoding/xml`](packages/encoding/xml.md) - Package xml implements a simple XML 1.0 parser that understands XML name spaces.
- [`errors`](packages/errors.md) - Package errors implements functions to manipulate errors.
- [`ffi`](packages/ffi.md) - Package ffi provides the low-level host call boundary used by optional capability libraries.
- [`fmt`](packages/fmt.md) - Package fmt implements Go-compatible string formatting and wrapped-error construction for Mini-Go values.
- [`hash`](packages/hash.md) - Package hash provides interfaces for hash functions.
- [`hash/crc32`](packages/hash/crc32.md) - Package crc32 implements the 32-bit cyclic redundancy check.
- [`hash/fnv`](packages/hash/fnv.md) - Package fnv implements FNV-1 and FNV-1a non-cryptographic hash functions.
- [`html`](packages/html.md) - Package html provides functions for escaping and unescaping HTML text.
- [`html/template`](packages/html/template.md) - Package template (html/template) implements data-driven templates for generating HTML output safe against code injection.
- [`io`](packages/io.md) - Package io provides basic interfaces to I/O primitives.
- [`io/fs`](packages/io/fs.md) - Package fs defines basic interfaces to a file system.
- [`iter`](packages/iter.md) - Package iter provides basic definitions and operations related to iterators over sequences.
- [`maps`](packages/maps.md) - Package maps defines various functions useful with maps of any type.
- [`math`](packages/math.md) - Package math provides basic constants and mathematical functions.
- [`math/bits`](packages/math/bits.md) - Package bits implements bit counting and manipulation functions for unsigned integer types.
- [`math/cmplx`](packages/math/cmplx.md) - Package cmplx provides basic constants and mathematical functions for complex numbers.
- [`math/floatbits`](packages/math/floatbits.md) - Package floatbits provides IEEE representation and scaling operations.
- [`math/rand/v2`](packages/math/rand/v2.md) - Package rand implements pseudo-random number generators suitable for tasks such as simulation, but it should not be used for security-sensitive work.
- [`net`](packages/net.md) - Package net provides portable network interfaces and in-memory connections.
- [`net/netip`](packages/net/netip.md) - Package netip defines an IP address type that's a small value type.
- [`net/textproto`](packages/net/textproto.md) - Package textproto implements generic support for text-based request/response protocols.
- [`net/url`](packages/net/url.md) - Package url parses URLs and implements query escaping.
- [`os`](packages/os.md) - Package os provides portable operating-system interfaces.
- [`path`](packages/path.md) - Package path implements utility routines for manipulating slash-separated paths.
- [`path/filepath`](packages/path/filepath.md) - Package filepath implements portable slash-separated path operations and filesystem helpers backed by the injected os filesystem.
- [`reflect`](packages/reflect.md) - Package reflect provides runtime type inspection and writable value access for Mini-Go values.
- [`reflect/inspect`](packages/reflect/inspect.md) - Package inspect provides small dynamic type queries and assignment without materializing reflection descriptors.
- [`regexp`](packages/regexp.md) - Package regexp implements regular expression search.
- [`regexp/syntax`](packages/regexp/syntax.md) - Package syntax parses regular expressions into parse trees and compiles parse trees into programs.
- [`rpc`](packages/rpc.md) - Package rpc provides the transport-neutral support used by generated MRPC clients and services.
- [`slices`](packages/slices.md) - Package slices defines various functions useful with slices of any type.
- [`sort`](packages/sort.md) - Package sort provides primitives for sorting slices and user-defined collections.
- [`strconv`](packages/strconv.md) - Package strconv implements conversions to and from string representations of basic data types.
- [`strconv/literal`](packages/strconv/literal.md) - Package literal decodes Go-style quoted literals without numeric formatting or Unicode tables.
- [`strings`](packages/strings.md) - Package strings implements simple functions to manipulate UTF-8 encoded strings.
- [`sync`](packages/sync.md) - Package sync provides basic synchronization primitives such as mutual exclusion locks.
- [`testing`](packages/testing.md) - Package testing provides the test state and report types used to execute Mini-Go *_test.mgo functions.
- [`testing/fstest`](packages/testing/fstest.md) - Package fstest implements support for testing implementations and users of file systems.
- [`text/tabwriter`](packages/text/tabwriter.md) - Package tabwriter implements a write filter (tabwriter.Writer) that translates tabbed columns in input into properly aligned text.
- [`text/template`](packages/text/template.md) - Package template implements data-driven templates for generating textual output.
- [`text/template/parse`](packages/text/template/parse.md) - Package parse builds parse trees for templates as defined by text/template and html/template.
- [`time`](packages/time.md) - Package time provides durations, Gregorian calendar values, formatting, parsing, clocks, and timers.
- [`unicode`](packages/unicode.md) - Package unicode provides data and functions to test some properties of Unicode code points.
- [`unicode/utf16`](packages/unicode/utf16.md) - Package utf16 implements encoding and decoding of UTF-16 sequences.
- [`unicode/utf8`](packages/unicode/utf8.md) - Package utf8 implements functions and constants to support text encoded in UTF-8.
- [`uuid`](packages/uuid.md) - Package uuid provides support for generating and manipulating UUIDs.
